notes: RULE 3 SANITY CHECK: verified genuine, currently operating company before extracting. /pages/mentions-legales shows real legal notice: societe FLEUX, SARL, VAT FR22481283901, address 39 rue Sainte-Croix de la Bretonnerie 75004 Paris (the well-known Fleux concept store in Le Marais, matching independently known facts about the brand); /pages/nos-boutiques lists real physical stores. QTY VERIFICATION: every leaf qty is an exact unique-product-ID count from paginated /collections/<handle>/products.json (limit=250, paged to exhaustion, IDs deduped) -- not the inflated Shopify collections.json products_count field. EXCLUDED WHOLESALE: Mobilier (furniture, all types), Lifestyle (fashion/wellness/hobby accessories) except the lighting item noted below, Linge de maison & tapis (textiles: cushions/rugs/bed linen), Linge de table (table linens), NEW/MUST HAVE/BRADERIE/Voir tout (marketing/sale nav, not categories), IDEES CADEAUX (gift-price-tier nav, not categories), GREEN (a sustainability/material facet cross-cut of the same Luminaire/Decoration/Mobilier/Lifestyle/Kids collections under -green handles -- pure facet re-cut, not a distinct catalogue). EXCLUDED MIXED-ROLLUP NODES (checked actual product titles/product_type, no clean split URL exists, so dropped rather than padded per brief): 'Bougies, bougeoirs et allumettes' (152 items: ~46% Allumettes/matches which are not decor, plus scented 'parfumee' candles mixed with unscented and with candle holders -- no separate holders-only or unscented-only listing); 'Assiettes & couverts' (95 items under handle assiettes: only 77% plates/bowls/wall-decor-plates, 23% Couverts/cutlery+kitchen utensils -- no separate plates-only listing); 'Petits rangements' and 'Paniers & boites' (both dominated by functional storage crates/tins/baskets, not decorative accessories); 'Sets de table & dessous de verre' (dominated by textile placemats, coasters/dessous-de-verre are a small minority with no standalone listing); 'Bouteilles & lunch box' (functional insulated travel bottles/tumblers and lunch boxes, not home-decor glassware/tableware); 'Ustensiles de cuisine' and 'Epicerie' (kitchen tools / food & drink consumables). DUPLICATE DROPPED: 'Decorations enfant' (53 items) is a 90.6% product-ID subset of 'Art mural' (48/53 identical product IDs) -- same wall-decor population cross-tagged for a kids audience, dropped as a same-population duplicate, not a genuine second nav branch. RULE 0 WIN: 'Mobiles & veilleuses enfant' (kids/nursery collection) kept in full -- despite living under the KIDS nav branch, all 21 products verified by title/product_type are night lights and portable LED lamps (Veilleuse/Lampe), zero actual baby-mobile toys found; included as Lighting > Kids Night Lights. Old room-word logic would have skipped this whole collection as 'kids', losing 21 legitimate lighting products. RULE 0.6 DOCUMENTED OVERLAPS (kept both branches, not dropped, since they are genuine separate site nav items, not the same URL/pure facet): Desk Lamps (36) is a 94% product-ID subset of Table Lamps (197, 34/36 shared) -- both are real distinct mega-menu links under the 'Lampes a poser' grouping, desk lamps are simply also merchandised inside the larger table-lamp bucket; Catchall Trays/vide-poches (51) and Platters & Trays/plats (105) overlap 13 products (25%/12%) -- two genuine distinct nav branches (decorative catch-all dishes vs tableware serving trays). Affiches & Tableaux (posters, 453) vs Art mural (3D wall objects/trophies/exvoto, 67) overlap only 4 products (~6-9%) -- genuinely distinct types, both kept. Parent grouping rows mirror the site's own MegaMenu column headers (Objets de decoration / Decoration murale / Rangements decoratifs / Vaisselle / Accessoires de table / Lampes a poser / Lampes murales / Accessoires luminaires), translated to English; Kids Night Lights is emitted as a standalone leaf since it is a single-item nav branch outside the Luminaire megamenu, not nested under any of those parent groupings.
